subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: If computed review depth or pass count falls below FR-25, a proposal reaches a zero-pass terminal, or required critical passes share a context/session/output lineage, review different revisions, or count a remediation re-review as an assurance pass, then the system shall refuse review completion and require the complete correctly floored assurance-pass set before the proposal can be accepted
intent: proposal remains unreviewed; the violated depth, pass count, revision binding, blindness, or pass-type condition is named
fit_criterion: depth-lowering, zero-pass, single-pass-critical, shared-context, output-leakage, mismatched-revision, and remediation-miscount fixtures produce no accepted review evidence and name the exact violated floor
